text: Time is fivefold; time destroys the elements and the world. Time remains awake even when all are asleep; indeed, time is insurmountable. The three categories of reality—the manifest, the unmanifest, and the Purusha—are all subsumed within time. Time is manifest because it is the agent of all actions. Even time’s primary cause, Prakriti (Nature), is absorbed here; therefore, time is not the ultimate cause.
